column1: # Wave B2 — every frame where (n-1)%3==2, each editing its own n-1 (a KIND-B1 frame).
# frame 3 was rendered in the B pilot and is already in the ledger; 117 rows here.
# Each change continues the two-beat arc its A frame and B1 frame started, into a third
# state. `loc` is the location of the base frame, not the nominal scene map — see the
# Same prompt shape as wave B1 (predecessor job_id as the ONE and ONLY medias entry):
#   Take the reference image and keep it EXACTLY: same composition, same crop, same
#   camera, same character, same colors, same background, same style. Change ONLY:
#   {change}. Do not redraw or re-stage anything else.
# No change here writes letters or numerals — the style formula forbids text, and a
# B edit that asks for a written number gets one rendered into the frame.
